# Unbroke

> Unbroke fixes broken vibe-coded apps (built with Cursor, Lovable, Bolt, Replit, v0, Claude Code). Agents diagnose the problem in an isolated sandbox, a human reviews every fix, and you get a plain-English explanation. A Zye.AI service.

## Pricing (USD)
- Quick Diagnosis: $29, within 24 hours. No fix found, no charge.
- Fix It: $149, within 48 hours, one issue, tested patch, one follow-up round. Refund if the patch doesn't solve your issue.
- Launch Check: $399, 3-5 business days. Security and stability scan, top-10 risks, fixes for the top 3.

## Safety
- Read-only repo access only; we never push to main or deploy for you
- Isolated, disposable sandboxes; secrets scrubbed; repo copies deleted after 14 days
- We never ask for passwords, API keys or production credentials
